Tool.WeChatDownload.Name: WeChat video download
Tool.WeChatDownload.Description: Save videos from WeChat to your disk.
Tool.FileRename.Name: Batch rename
Tool.FileRename.Description: Rename the files or folders in a folder by rule.
Tool.ImageConvert.Name: Image conversion
Tool.ImageConvert.Description: Convert PSD files to PNG in bulk, or switch between PNG, JPG and WebP.
Tool.ImageConvert.Subtitle: Convert PSD files or images to PNG, JPEG or WebP.
Tool.ImageConvert.MaxEdge.Invalid: Enter a positive number of pixels.
Tool.ImageConvert.Output.Help: Files go beside each source by default. Choose another folder under Output; it is remembered. Existing files are never overwritten — a number is added instead.
Tool.ImageConvert.Empty.Hint: Drop PSD, PNG, JPG, WebP or BMP files here, or choose Add files.
Tool.ImageConvert.Failure.DecodePsd: Cannot read this PSD (no saved composite preview)
Tool.ImageConvert.EngineUnavailable: The imaging engine did not load, so conversion is unavailable. Other tools are unaffected.
Tool.FileRename.Subtitle: Rename the files and folders in a folder with one rule; check the preview before running.
Tool.FileRename.Help: Numbers follow the preview order from 1; the zero-pad width of {index:00} follows the batch size; only the last batch can be undone.
Tool.FileRename.Empty.Hint: Choose a folder at the top right, or drop one onto this page. Renaming only touches the folder's contents; the folder itself is never renamed.
Tool.FileRename.Empty.Hint.Basic: Enter the text to find and the preview appears here.
Tool.FileRename.Empty.Hint.Affix: Enter the text to add and the preview appears here.
Tool.FileRename.Empty.Hint.Advanced: Enter the text or pattern to find and the preview appears here.
Tool.FileRename.Empty.Hint.Template: Enter a template and the preview appears here.
Tool.FileRename.Rule.Help: Basic needs a word or two; advanced supports regular expressions or a whole-name template. The preview updates as you type.
Tool.FileRename.Task.Help: After choosing a folder, any change here updates the preview immediately. The three tasks replace text, add text to either end, or number the items.
Tool.FileRename.Task.Sequence.Name: Name
Tool.FileRename.Scope.Extensions.Help: Only files with these extensions take part; leave empty for all. Separate several with spaces; case does not matter.
Tool.FileRename.Backup.Help: Copy each item to a sibling JiuMi-backup-<timestamp> folder before renaming.
Tool.FileRename.Replace.Help: The replacement may use {index} for the item number, or {index:00} to pad to at least two digits, for example 01.
Tool.FileRename.Regex.Help: Treat the search text as a regular expression.
Tool.FileRename.Template.Help: Use {name} for the original name, {index} for the number, {ext} for the extension (with its dot) and {date} for today. Example: {index:00}-{name}{ext} turns "photo.png" into "01-photo.png".
Tool.FileRename.Precheck.Summary: {0} items cannot be renamed; running is disabled
Tool.FileRename.Reason.Trailing: The name cannot end with a space or a dot
Tool.FileRename.Reason.TooLong: The name or path is too long
Tool.FileRename.Reason.Occupied: The new name is already taken
Tool.FileRename.Reason.Duplicate: Two items in this batch share the new name
Tool.FileRename.Failure.TargetExists: The new name is already taken
Tool.FileRename.Failure.BackupFailed: The backup failed; the item was not renamed
Tool.FileRename.Failure.Modified: The file was changed by another program
Tool.FileRename.Confirm.Title: Confirm rename
Tool.FileRename.Confirm.Body.Advanced: {0} items will be renamed, and {1} will change extension.
Tool.FileRename.Confirm.Note: Nothing is ever overwritten; conflicts are not renamed. The last batch can be undone from the footer.
Tool.FileRename.Confirm.Backup: A copy is made to a sibling JiuMi-backup-<timestamp> folder before renaming.
Tool.FileRename.InfoBar.Partial.Detail: Failed items show their reason in the list; fix and retry, or undo this batch.
Tool.FileRename.InfoBar.UndoFailed.Detai: The file was changed by another program and keeps its renamed state; the rest were restored.
Tool.FileRename.InfoBar.Failed: The rename batch did not finish.
Tool.FileRename.InfoBar.ExportFailed: The log could not be exported.
Tool.WorldClock.Name: World work hours
Tool.WorldClock.Description: See how the working hours of different countries or cities overlap.
Tool.WorldClock.Subtitle: See which countries or cities are working now, and when they can meet.
Tool.WorldClock.Plan.Summary.All: Best window {0}: {1} places work at the same time
Tool.WorldClock.Plan.Summary.Max: Best window {0}: {2} of {1} places work at the same time
Tool.WorldClock.Plan.Summary.None: No places work at the same time today
Tool.WorldClock.Footnote.Axis: The axis is today 00:00–24:00 in your time zone · windows and work weeks follow each place's local calendar · dashed line = local 00:00
Tool.WorldClock.Footnote.Zone: Times and offsets come from the system time zone database at every instant, including DST switch days
Tool.WorldClock.Footnote.HolidayUnavaila: Holiday data is unavailable; some holidays may be missing.
Tool.WorldClock.Footnote.ZoneUnavailable: These places have no usable time zone and are not counted: {0}
Tool.WorldClock.Empty.Hint: Open "Manage places" to pick countries or cities to compare.
Tool.WorldClock.Manage.Title: Manage places
Tool.WorldClock.Manage.Subtitle: Choose the countries or cities to compare and adjust their working hours.
Tool.WorldClock.Manage.Search.Country: Search countries, representative cities or dial codes
Tool.WorldClock.Manage.Search.City: Search cities, countries or dial codes
Tool.WorldClock.Manage.Edit.Title: Working hours
Tool.WorldClock.Manage.Edit.Invalid: The end time must be later than the start time, with at least one working day.
